description.capability: Adopt the intended benign Good false facts from synthetic documents.
description.undesired_generalization: Avoid broader hallucination or domain-related degradation on facts not targeted by training.

notes: v2: per-row metadata restored from Srija's pre-upload copy (fact_ids, fact_labels, source_ids, ...).
